Her clinical background includes working as a school nurse at a private school in Newton, MA since 2018, in addition to her work at Newton Beauty, where she focuses on aesthetic and wellness treatments. A lifelong resident of Newton and a proud mother of four, Nancy understands the importance of feeling your best—both inside and out. At Newton Beauty, Nancy offers Botox injections , skin rejuvenation, IV wellness therapy , and supportive wellness treatments . Her approach combines clinical expertise with a personalized touch to help clients achieve natural, refreshed results while supporting energy, vitality, and overall well-being. Mission Statement At Newton Beauty, we enhance natural beauty, vitality, and overall wellness through personalized, results-driven treatments. We are committed to providing thoughtful, individualized care in a welcoming, professional environment so every client leaves feeling confident, refreshed, and supported. Welcome to Newton Beauty Medical Aesthetics in Newton, MA Why I Love What I Do With over 25 years of nursing experience, I’m passionate about helping people feel confident and refreshed. At Newton Beauty, I provide Botox, facials, IV therapy, and supportive wellness treatments with a focus on natural, balanced results. I also collaborate with an experienced Nurse Practitioner to offer advanced aesthetic services within the practice, including dermal fillers, Sculptra®, and Radiesse® biostimulator treatments, as well as supportive wellness programs—ensuring clients have access to comprehensive, personalized care. My focus is on providing thoughtful, personalized care in a welcoming, professional environment. Whether you’re seeking aesthetic treatments or supportive wellness services, my goal is to help you look and feel your best. Book Online Meet the Team at Newton Beauty - Newton, MA Nancy Landry, RN, Owner & Nurse Injector With over 25 years of nursing experience, Nancy Landry blends clinical expertise with a passion for aesthetics. A lifelong Newton resident and mother of four, she focuses on Botox , skin rejuvenation, IV therapy , and supportive wellness service —delivering safe, natural results that enhance confidence and overall well-being. Consultation with Nancy Landry, RN Elizandra “Ellie” Adams, APRN, FNP-BC Ellie specializes in medical aesthetics, metabolic wellness, and hormone balance. With over a decade of clinical and research experience, she combines advanced medical knowledge with a supportive, patient-focused approach to help clients achieve natural results. As a Clinical Research Coordinator at Boston Medical Center, she remains at the forefront of emerging treatments in aesthetics, weight management, and metabolic wellness, ensuring care is evidence-based and highly personalized. Ellie provides services through her own independent medical practice, including Botox injections , dermal fillers , lip fillers , peptides, PRP therapy, Sculptra ®, biostimulators , weight management with prescription medications , hormone optimization , and in-house lab testing. These services are not provided, supervised, or directed by Newton Beauty. All medical decision-making and clinical care are the responsibility of the independent provider. Fluent in Portuguese and Spanish, Ellie creates personalized treatment plans that feel natural, empowering, and aligned with long-term wellness goals.
